create_CtcCriterionConfig: create a CtcCriterionConfig dataclass to configure CTC loss with zero infinity and WER settings
build_CtcCriterion: build a CtcCriterion instance with config and task to compute CTC loss for speech recognition
run_CtcCriterion_forward: run the CtcCriterion forward method to compute CTC loss and logging output for a model sample
review_CtcCriterion_reduce_metrics: review the CtcCriterion reduce_metrics method to aggregate loss and WER metrics across data parallel workers
test_CtcCriterion_wer_decoding: test the CtcCriterion WER decoding with kenlm model to evaluate word error rate on predictions
